# spoke_grant (Resource)

Experimental grant lifecycle against the provisional mock-v5 API. Requires organization-scoped configuration (or a matching project assertion for environments). No production platform service is qualified. Deletion never cascades to independent children or grants.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Experimental mock-v5 contract; no live platform API is qualified.
resource "spoke_project" "application" {
  management_key = "application-project"
  name           = "application"
}

resource "spoke_environment" "production" {
  project_id     = spoke_project.application.resource_id
  management_key = "production-environment"
  name           = "production"
}

resource "spoke_service_account" "application" {
  management_key = "application-identity"
  name           = "application"
}

resource "spoke_grant" "read" {
  management_key = "application-read"
  name           = "application-read"
  subject_id     = spoke_service_account.application.resource_id
  target         = spoke_environment.production.target_path
  permission     = "read"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `management_key` (String) Stable, non-secret recovery key, unique per independently managed resource.
- `name` (String) Mutable display name; never an adoption key.
- `permission` (String) Explicit permission. manage includes read; no grant is created implicitly by a binding or login.
- `subject_id` (String) Exact service-account ID in this organization. Credential issuance remains external.
- `target` (String) Existing object's target_path or `/v5/organizations/{organization_id}`. Authority includes descendants. Changing the target replaces the owned grant.

### Optional

- `deletion_protection` (Boolean) Refuse deletion while enabled. Dependent resources restrict deletion even when protection is disabled. Defaults to true except for grants.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Canonical import ID: `organization_id/resource_id`, or `organization_id/project_id/environment_id` for an environment.
- `owner_id` (String) Authenticated management principal. Import does not transfer ownership.
- `resource_id` (String) Opaque ID for references and explicit provider target assertions.
- `revision` (Number) Observed native revision used for mutation preconditions.
- `target_path` (String) Exact management target path, usable by explicit grants.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import spoke_grant.read org-example/grant-example
```
